events.summary: The twins volunteer to travel with Basri Ket, Mahitab and Niharet across the Broken Lands to Temmet's tomb.
events.quote: They both volunteered to travel with Basri Ket

events.summary: A sandwurm attacks and severely injures Merinaten; Basri topples it and Mahitab kills it.
Niharet betrays the group to Munhatep at the tomb.
events.quote: Niharet betrayed the group to the monarch Munhatep

events.summary: Marunaten sees Ketramose tear off the pyramid roof, assail Munhatep and revive Temmet.
events.quote: He witnessed Ketramose tear off the roof of the pyramid
